title: JLPT N5 Kanji & Reading Track

sources.name: KANJIDIC2
sources.publisher: Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group (EDRDG)
sources.use: Kanji readings (on/kun), English meanings and the old 4-level JLPT tag. Every reading and meaning in kanji.json must be a member of the KANJIDIC2 entry.

sources.name: JMdict (queried through the Jisho.org API)
sources.use: Vocabulary spellings, readings and glosses, and the reading of every kanji run used in sentences and passages. Distractor spellings are checked so that none is a real word with the same reading.

sources.name: Original material
sources.use: Example sentences, reading passages and comprehension questions are original text written for this app. They are NOT copied from any textbook or JLPT examination.

jlptNote: The JLPT has published no official kanji list since 2010. 'N5' membership here follows the old level-4 tag in KANJIDIC2 plus kanji that N5 vocabulary needs. 曜 is tagged old level 3 in KANJIDIC2 but is included because 〜曜日 (days of the week) is core N5 vocabulary.

review.kanji: Readings and meanings are machine-checked against KANJIDIC2. A proficient reader should still confirm the selection of taught readings.
review.vocabulary: Spellings and readings are machine-checked against JMdict. English glosses are shortened by hand.
review.sentences: Original text. Spelling/readings are machine-checked, but naturalness is NOT checked. NEEDS REVIEW by a proficient Japanese speaker.
review.passages: Original text. NEEDS REVIEW by a proficient Japanese speaker (naturalness, level, answer uniqueness).
review.questions: Original questions and hand-picked distractors. NEEDS REVIEW by a proficient Japanese speaker.
